BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_practice_task_final_review (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_practice_task_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_practice_task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    student_practice_task_milestone_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_practice_task_milestone(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    task_answer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_task_answer(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    artifact_id uuid NULL REFERENCES student_practice_task_artifact(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    submission_number integer NOT NULL CHECK (submission_number > 0),
    status smallint NOT NULL CHECK (status BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
    ai_status smallint NOT NULL CHECK (ai_status BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
    ai_result_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    ai_error text NULL,
    mentor_status smallint NOT NULL CHECK (mentor_status BETWEEN 0 AND 3),
    mentor_id uuid NULL,
    mentor_feedback text NULL,
    mentor_score numeric(6,2) NULL,
    deterministic_report_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    submitted_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    reviewed_at timestamptz NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (student_practice_task_id, submission_number)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_practice_task_final_review_open
    ON student_practice_task_final_review(student_practice_task_id)
    WHERE status IN (0, 1, 4);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_practice_task_final_review_queue
    ON student_practice_task_final_review(status, submitted_at);

COMMIT;
